label: Season
description: Seasonal dressing for any outdoor scene — palette, ground state and air named in every item.

items.name: spring-bloom
items.text: early spring, fresh chartreuse shoots on dark wet branches and drifting blossom petals gathering in pale drifts along every edge

items.name: high-summer
items.text: high summer, saturated deep greens under a strong high sun, cool blue shade pooling beneath heavy canopies

items.name: late-summer-gold
items.text: late summer, dry golden grasses gone to seed, low warm sun and fine dust hanging in the air

items.name: autumn-foliage
items.text: peak autumn, crimson and amber foliage overhead and a fresh leaf-fall carpeting the ground in the same palette

items.name: late-autumn-bare
items.text: late autumn, bare black branches against a pale sky, low colorless sun and long blue shadows across frosted grass

items.name: deep-winter
items.text: deep winter, thick unbroken snow rounding every shape, breath hanging as fog in the frozen stillness

items.name: winter-thaw
items.text: the first thaw, patchy grey snow receding into dark soaked earth, icicles dripping and every gutter running

items.name: monsoon-lush
items.text: monsoon season, dripping oversaturated greenery, heavy humid air and warm rain streaking through it
